```{r echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(CellChat)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(introdataviz)
library(ggtext)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(cowplot)
source("script/netVisual_diffInteraction_fixed.R")

lacols<-c("LA+"="#8DB600","LA-"="#5E4FA2",none="white")
```

# Neighbors
```{r echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
files<-list.files()
files<-files[str_detect(files,"bg")]#no endometrioma
metadata<-lapply(files,vroom::vroom)%>%bind_rows()

files<-list.files("nets",full.names = T)
files<-files[str_detect(files,"delau")]
edges<-lapply(files, read_csv)
names(edges)<-str_remove_all(files,"nets/|delaunay.+")
edges<-lapply(names(edges), function(x) 
  edges[[x]]%>%mutate(Run_Tissue_name=x))%>%bind_rows()
edges<-edges%>%filter(distance<=0.1)
edges<-edges%>%mutate(from=paste0(Run_Tissue_name,from),to=paste0(Run_Tissue_name,to))
edges<-metadata%>%
    select(cell_ID,fov_type,dom_nEndoh1_75)%>%
    right_join(edges,by = c("cell_ID"="from"))
colnames(edges)[1:3]<-c("from","type_from","dom_from")
edges<-metadata%>%
    select(cell_ID,fov_type,dom_nEndoh1_75)%>%
    right_join(edges,by = c("cell_ID"="to"))
colnames(edges)[1:3]<-c("to","type_to","dom_to")
edges<-metadata%>%distinct(Run_Tissue_name,Class)%>%right_join(edges)
edges<-edges%>%mutate(homodom=dom_to==dom_from,
                      homotypic=type_from==type_to)

edges<-edges%>%filter(homodom==F)
edges<-edges%>%filter(dom_to==6|dom_from==6)
gc()
edges<-edges%>%mutate(interacting_dom=ifelse(dom_to==6,dom_from,dom_to),
                      interacting_ct=ifelse(dom_to==6,type_from,type_to))
edges<-edges%>%mutate(index=case_when(interacting_dom==6~1,
                                    interacting_dom==3~2,
                                    interacting_dom==4~3,
                                    interacting_dom==2~4,
                                    interacting_dom==1~6,
                                    TRUE~interacting_dom))#as defined in Fig2
temp<-edges%>%count(index,interacting_ct)%>%
  filter(!interacting_ct%in%c("unknown","low_signal"))
temp1<-temp%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = index,values_from = n,values_fill = 0)%>%
  column_to_rownames("interacting_ct")%>%chisq.test()
temp<-temp1$residuals%>%as.data.frame()%>%
  rownames_to_column("interacting_ct")%>%
  pivot_longer(-1,names_to = "index",values_to = "chisq_residuals")%>%
  mutate(index=as.numeric(index))%>%inner_join(temp)

pA0<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=index,y=interacting_ct,fill=chisq_residuals))+
  geom_raster()+scale_fill_gradient2(low="#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
  theme_minimal()+labs(x="Domain",y="",fill="Enrichment")
pA00<-temp%>%group_by(index)%>%summarise(n=sum(n))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=index,y=n))+geom_col()+theme_classic()

plot_grid(pA00+theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),axis.line.x = element_blank(),
                     plot.margin=grid::unit(c(0,0,-5,0),"mm"))+labs(x=""),
          pA0+theme_bw()+theme(panel.grid = element_blank()),nrow=2,
          align = "v",axis = "lr",rel_heights = c(.4,.6))

```

# Cell chat
```{r echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cc_res<-readRDS("data/CellChat_PE_hasLA_exclude.rds")

cts<-rownames(cc_res[[1]]@net$`TRUE`$count)

                          measure = "count",
                          sources.use = "EnEpi cells",

                          weight.scale = T)

                          measure = "count",
                          targets.use = "EnEpi cells",
                          remove.isolate = T,
                          weight.scale = T)
pA2<-netVisual_diffInteraction(cc_res[[1]],#color.use = alt_cellcols,
                          measure = "count",
                          sources.use = "EnS cells",
                          #targets.use = cts[str_detect(cts,"Smo|En|Mes|Ery",negate=T)],
                          remove.isolate = T,
                          weight.scale = T)
pA3<-netVisual_diffInteraction(cc_res[[1]],#color.use = alt_cellcols,
                          measure = "count",
                          targets.use = "EnS cells",
                          remove.isolate = T,
                          weight.scale = T)

## top pathways/ct
pairs <- list("LA-"=subsetCommunication(cc_res$`FALSE`),
              "LA+"=subsetCommunication(cc_res$`TRUE`))
pairs<-lapply(names(pairs), function(x) pairs[[x]]%>%mutate(has_LA=x))%>%bind_rows()
pairs<-pairs%>%filter(source!="Erythrocytes"&target!="Erythrocytes")
temp<-pairs%>%filter((source=="EnEpi cells"&str_detect(target,"Smo|En|Mes|Ery",negate=T))|
                     (target=="EnEpi cells"&str_detect(source,"Smo|En|Mes|Ery",negate=T)))
deg<-read_csv("docs/all_pseudobulkDEG_scavg.csv")
sources<-temp%>%mutate(ct=source,gene=ligand)%>%distinct(ct,gene)%>%inner_join(deg)
targets<-temp%>%mutate(ct=target,gene=receptor)%>%distinct(ct,gene)%>%inner_join(deg)
```

# Top enrichment
```{r echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
gsea_bp<-read_csv("docs/has_laDEG-nosubbulk-GSEA-BPsimpl.csv")

i<-gsea_bp%>%filter(str_detect(ct,"En"))%>%
  separate_rows(core_enrichment,sep = '/')%>%
  distinct(ct,core_enrichment)
colnames(i)[2]<-"gene"
subdeg<-deg%>%group_by(ct)%>%
  filter(`LA-`>quantile(`LA-`,.95)|`LA+`>quantile(`LA+`,.95))

subdeg<-subdeg%>%slice_max(abs(avg_log2FC),n=20)
subdeg<-gsea_bp%>%separate_rows(core_enrichment,sep = '/')%>%
  mutate(gene=core_enrichment)%>%select(Description,NES,gene,ct)%>%
  right_join(subdeg,by=c("ct","gene"))
subdeg<-subdeg%>%mutate(diff=`LA+`-`LA-`)%>%
  filter((avg_log2FC>0&diff>0&NES>0)|(avg_log2FC<0&diff<0&NES<0))%>%
  select(-c(p_val,pct.1,pct.2,NES))%>%group_by(ct,gene)%>%
  mutate(Description=paste(sort(unique(Description)),collapse = ','))%>%distinct()
#chose fro subdeg
enepgenes<-c("SFRP4","IGFBP5","TXNIP","IGF1","COL3A1")
ensgenes<-c("METRN","CD81","FBLN1","WNT5A","GBP1")
enepaths<-c("Wnt signaling pathway",
            "epithelial cell proliferation",
            "response to estradiol",
            "muscle cell migration",
            "cell-matrix adhesion")
enspaths<-c("positive regulation of neurogenesis",
            "leukocyte cell-cell adhesion",
            "wound healing",
            "endothelial cell proliferation",
            "response to type II interferon")
gsea_bp%>%filter(Description%in%enepaths&ct=="EnEpi cells")%>%
    arrange(NES)%>%mutate(Description=factor(Description,
                                             levels = unique(Description)))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=NES,y=Description,col=NES,size=p.adjust))+geom_point()+
    scale_color_gradient2(low="#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
    scale_size(range=c(3,5))+theme_classic()+theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
gsea_bp%>%filter(Description%in%enspaths&ct=="EnS cells")%>%
    arrange(NES)%>%mutate(Description=factor(Description,
                                             levels = unique(Description)))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=NES,y=Description,col=NES,size=p.adjust))+geom_point()+
    scale_color_gradient2(low="#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
    scale_size(range=c(3,5))+theme_classic()+theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

```

# Top genes
```{r echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sc<-readRDS("data/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class=="Peritoneal endometriosis"))
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%mutate(has_LA=ifelse(LA_per_Sample>0,"LA+","LA-"))
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_remove(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type," \\(.+"))%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_replace(nosub,"Memmo","Memo"))
gc()


DotPlot(subset(sc,subset = harmonized_major_cell_type=="EnEpi cells"),
            features = enepgenes,group.by = "has_LA")+coord_flip()+
    scale_color_gradient2(low="#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
    scale_size(range=c(1,5))+theme(axis.text = element_text(size=11))
DotPlot(subset(sc,subset = harmonized_major_cell_type=="EnS cells"),
            features = ensgenes,group.by = "has_LA")+coord_flip()+
    scale_color_gradient2(low="#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
    scale_size(range=c(1,5))+theme(axis.text = element_text(size=11))

```

# Progeny
```{r echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
progeny<-data.table::fread("data/progeney_scores.tsv")
progeny<-sc@meta.data%>%rownames_to_column("Cell")%>%
  select(Cell,has_LA,harmonized_major_cell_type,SampleName)%>%
  inner_join(progeny)

progeny%>%filter(harmonized_major_cell_type=="EnEpi cells")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=has_LA,y=Estrogen,colour = has_LA))+
  geom_violin()+geom_boxplot(width=.1)+
  stat_compare_means(label='p.signif',comparisons = list(c("LA+","LA-")))+
  theme_classic()+labs(x="")+scale_color_manual(values=lacols)+
  theme(legend.position = "n")
progeny%>%filter(harmonized_major_cell_type=="EnEpi cells")%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=has_LA,y=WNT,colour = has_LA))+
    geom_violin()+geom_boxplot(width=.1)+
    stat_compare_means(label='p.signif',comparisons = list(c("LA+","LA-")))+
    theme_classic()+labs(x="")+scale_color_manual(values=lacols)+
  theme(legend.position = "n")
progeny%>%filter(harmonized_major_cell_type=="EnS cells")%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=has_LA,y=TGFb,colour = has_LA))+
    geom_violin()+geom_boxplot(width=.1)+
    stat_compare_means(label='p.signif',comparisons = list(c("LA+","LA-")))+
    theme_classic()+labs(x="")+scale_color_manual(values=lacols)+
  theme(legend.position = "n")

```
